findings.highlight: Those who seek salvation in this otherwordly realm, who rejoice in this bizarre sight, must only be the sort of demons who flee the light of the sun.
findings.evidenceJa: このような異界に救いを求め、このような異景を祭ろうとするモノは、陽の光から逃れる蛇蠍魔蠍の類に違いない。

findings.highlight: Dressed in black curses, she stares absently at the approaching skull
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い呪いに身を包んだ少女は、迫り来る髑髏をぼんやりと見つめている。
findings.governingReading: Complete source sentence ends normally after blankly watching skull.

findings.highlight: Even the priest's holy words cannot destroy the old mage, as long as the insects that comprise his real body remain intact.
findings.evidenceJa: いかに神父の聖言とて、本体である虫を潰さねばこの老魔術師は滅びない。
findings.governingReading: His actual host is the hidden worm distinct from crushed forest swarm;15 explicitly 一匹 and16 identifies heart parasite.
findings.explanation: Single hidden anchor worm becomes a body composed of insects.

findings.highlight: His real body, the host for his decaying soul, is the pseudo-nerves enervating Sakura Matou's heart.
findings.evidenceJa: その本体、腐敗する魂を繋ぎ止める依り代は、間桐桜の心臓に潜む擬似神経体だったのだ。
findings.governingReading: Soul-host is a pseudo-neural entity concealed in Sakura's heart.
findings.explanation: Heart-hidden pseudo-neural host becomes nerves enervating heart.

findings.highlight: There is a slippery sound of wriggling blood vessels.
findings.evidenceJa: ずるずると血管を這う音がする。
findings.governingReading: Sound is something crawling along blood vessels as worm receives brain-eating command.
findings.explanation: Crawling through vessels becomes vessels wriggling.

findings.highlight: "Disappear, lord of the mountain. You're nobody, just an assassin. You will never be a true Hassan."
findings.evidenceJa: 「消えなさい山の主。貴方は何者でもない一人の暗殺者、ただ一人の本物になど成れないわ」
findings.governingReading: Sakura denies that the skull-masked assassin can become the sole authentic Hassan, following her rejection of his wish to recover his name.
findings.explanation: Sakura's denial of becoming the one authentic Hassan becomes a denial of being a true Hassan. The loss concerns the skull-masked assassin's desired identity.

findings.highlight: The girl gouges out her own body, tearing her own nerves to shreds, all while giggling coolly.
findings.evidenceJa: 自らの身体を抉り、全身の神経がズタズタになりそうな行為を、少女は涼しげに笑いながらやってのけた。
findings.governingReading: Sakura performs an act that seems liable to shred the nerves throughout her body, while remaining outwardly cool.
findings.explanation: An act that seems capable of shredding her nerves becomes one that does shred them. The English removes the qualification while preserving her cool demeanor.

findings.highlight: "I should thank that priest. If he hadn't erased the rest of you, you might have really eaten me."
findings.evidenceJa: 「あの神父さんには感謝しないといけませんね。あの方がお爺さまを消してくださらなかったら、本当にわたしが食べられていたところだった」
findings.governingReading: Without priest's destruction of the other body she truly would have been eaten.
findings.explanation: Certain counterfactual consumption becomes might have eaten.

findings.highlight: So... she only had to wait until it was time to raise the flag of rebellion.
findings.evidenceJa: こうして—少女が老魔術師に反旗を翻すこの時までは。
findings.governingReading: Until this present revolt, unhidden takeover aim and her nonresistance made the old hierarchy unproblematic.
findings.explanation: Hierarchy remained until revolt becomes Sakura waited for rebellion time.
